decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system fits the firm's core office offering and its strategic push toward flexible, high-quality workplace solutions.
A chair family is a core furniture category for a premium interior brand and is likely to remain important across both residential and commercial projects.
The floor cushions broaden the firm's textile-led interior concept, but as a more niche accessory line they face a somewhat higher pruning risk than core furniture.
The upholstered sofa is close to the established living and lounge business and matches the firm's emphasis on timeless design and designer collaboration.
The high standing table supports contemporary collaborative work settings and complements the firm's office and conference portfolio.
Although rugs are more distant from the historic core, this collection was presented as a strategic focus and strengthens the firm's move toward complete interior solutions.
